status: specification written before any v2.1 run; E-DATA1 and E-CAL1 thresholds are the ones committed in research/gated_plan/registry.json at c3d2345 before this block
registration: development record only (registry.development_record, registered: false). The working tree holds another session's uncommitted repository reorganisation, so registry.register refuses it. This is disclosed, not a registration.

P0-1_design_menu.rule: the legal menu of a compound is the set of tier conditions the study design planned for it (research/protocol_v2/design.py); a planned condition without a usable prepared row is a measurement that ran and failed QC: offered, charged, recorded as measured_qc_failed, never read as biology
P0-1_design_menu.v2_mapping: contracts.v2_state is lossless: measured_valid + readout -> measured_<readout>; measured_qc_failed -> quality_failed; every other lifecycle -> not_measured
P0-1_design_menu.eligibility: SciPlex3 tier B: any planned tier condition; tier A: a planned 72 h condition; L1000: every tier condition planned (v2 required every condition to have passed QC)

P0-2_fold_pools.rule: hypothesis pools from each fold's training compounds only: SciPlex3 B >= 3 training skeleton units per class; SciPlex3 A >= 2 training compounds planned at 72 h per class; L1000 >= 6 training identities planned at every tier condition, of which >= 2 detected at a tier condition (contracts.fold_pools)
P0-2_fold_pools.consequence_known_before_running: classes that qualified only because a held-out compound was counted leave that fold's pool; their held-out compounds become unscorable on the mechanism endpoint. Pools shrink in 18 of 20 tasks (a construction check run before this file was written; no outcome was read).

P0-3_weighting.rule: primary estimate: the unit mean (each independent unit weighs 1; its episodes are averaged first); the episode mean is reported beside it. Intervals: 95% unit-cluster percentile bootstrap, 2,000 draws, seed 20260927, resampling units for both estimates (headroom.unit_paired)

E-DATA1.question: does any development task and measured-condition menu have enough headroom and independent units for planner work, once the menu and pools no longer read held-out outcomes
E-DATA1.tasks: SciPlex3 A and B, L1000 LT and T, 5 folds each, forced-choice episodes of tasks_v21.episode_list

arms_derived.fixed_star: cross-fitted best fixed sequence: for fold f, every legal sequence of at most max_measurements tier conditions (time order and day budget of the runner setting) is scored on the exact outcome tables of the other four folds' episodes; the sequence with the highest unit-mean correct rate is applied to fold f; ties by fewer measurements, then lexicographic action order
arms_derived.table_oracle: best legal sequence per episode from the exact outcome tables (correct over undetermined or deferred over wrong; ties by fewer measurements); must equal the oracle arm's terminal decisions on the full menu

estimands: headroom_correct = oracle - fixed_star (primary) and oracle - fixed, unit mean and episode mean
units required for +0.02 from the belief arm's paired SE against fixed (2.80 SE)
menu expansion: oracle ceiling of SciPlex3 A (24 h and 72 h) against its 24 h conditions only; oracle ceiling of L1000 LT (four lines) against its A549 conditions only, on identical episodes
QC-failed steps created by the design menu

thresholds.primary_eligible: headroom_correct (oracle - fixed_star, unit mean) >= 0.04 and lower 95% bound >= 0.02
thresholds.menu_expansion_qualifies: delta oracle ceiling >= 0.02 with lower bound > 0, or fixed_star uses >= 0.1 fewer measurements with correct >= -0.01 and wrong <= +0.005

E-DATA1.failure_rule: if no task and menu qualifies: stop planner-superiority work on these data; keep the tasks as regression and safety tests; the next step is a data census
E-DATA1.exposure: all development data are fully exposed; results are qualification statements, not performance claims

E-CAL1.question: do wrong-elimination forecasts, or a registered bound on them, cover observed rates on the actions each arm actually selected, per step and per episode, across studies
E-CAL1.items: executed measured_valid steps of belief, safe and myopic_edv in the E-DATA1 v2.1 records (per step), and decided episodes (per episode: forecast = 1 - product over executed steps of (1 - step forecast))
E-CAL1.fitting: leave-one-study-out: fitted on SciPlex3, tested on L1000 GSE92742, and the reverse
E-CAL1.stop_gate: a bound covers the observed wrong rate overall and in >= 95% of strata with >= 20 items on both targets, no stratum significantly above it, and its mean is <= 3 x the observed rate (informativeness clause, new in the gated plan)
E-CAL1.failure_rule: no forecast-driven stop and no risk claim

claims_not_allowed: external validity; GSE70138 is consumed and is not used here
